dialogue: Hello! Im Rapps. What's your deal?
Oh, I see, so your wings are damage.
AANNNNDD you can't find your parents?
DANG, that sucks. Uh, sorry to hear that.
Sorry I wish I could say I'd seen your parents come this way.
They might've even walked past me.
But, well,,, I wouldn't have noticed...
I was too busy staring at the SLIMES.
OHH, you know maybe they entered [color=#47f641]The SLIME ZONE[/color]?
Ok probably not, but you could check?
But, if you want to enter [color=#47f641]the SLIME ZONE[/color], you gotta pass my test
Ok, see how these [color=#47f641]slimes[/color] are kinda in this gap here?
You gotta cross from one side to the other.
[color=#f8c868]WITHOUT. TOUCHING. THE. GROUND.[/color]
Yep, you'll have to bounce on [color=#47f641]slimes[/color] to get across.
If you can do that, then I'll trust you with the [color=#47f641]slime zone[/color]
Sorry, it probably seems arbitrary, but, well,
You'll understand why once you get in there.
If you want a tip,,, you bounce higher off them, the faster you fall onto them.
Good luck.
